_about: Three invented works for the offline science cases (placeholder authors, a demo DOI prefix, no real paper). world.py turns them into OpenAlex-shaped records for the fake OpenAlex transport; the abstracts are plain text here.

works.title: Cycling as cross-training to maintain aerobic fitness during lower-limb injury: a systematic review
works.abstract: We reviewed 14 studies of cycling used as cross-training while an athlete could not run. Aerobic capacity was maintained in most studies. Study quality was mixed and most samples were small.

works.title: Low-impact aerobic exercise after a knee ligament strain: a small randomised trial
works.abstract: In 38 adults recovering from a knee ligament strain, stationary cycling three times a week kept aerobic fitness close to baseline. The trial was small and followed people for eight weeks only.

works.title: Keeping running fitness without running: a narrative review
works.abstract: A narrative review of coaching practice. It suggests cycling and swimming can limit fitness loss but reports no measurements.
